test_objectives.statement: The selected test expects the resulting build plan to use base image adoptopenjdk:8-jre, the linux/amd64 platform, and epoch creation time.
test_objectives.condition: For the selected visible test case.

test_objectives.statement: The selected test expects a four-element Java entrypoint and one classes layer containing the visible class file entry.
test_objectives.condition: For the selected visible test case.

test_objectives.statement: The selected test expects Docker format, empty environment, labels, volumes, and exposed ports, plus null user and working directory.
test_objectives.condition: For the selected visible test case.

scenario_hypotheses.description: No explicit base image is configured; the processor reports a Java version at most 8; its visible layer and computed entrypoint feed the returned builder.
scenario_hypotheses.condition: getFrom() is absent, getJavaVersion() is <= 8, and getEntrypoint() is empty.

scenario_hypotheses.description: An explicitly configured base image may also lead to the visible expected plan if ContainerBuilders.create returns a compatible builder.
scenario_hypotheses.condition: getFrom() is present and the hidden ContainerBuilders implementation produces the expected base image and plan defaults.

scenario_hypotheses.description: A configured custom entrypoint can satisfy the visible entrypoint assertions without calling processor.computeEntrypoint.
scenario_hypotheses.condition: getEntrypoint() returns the four visible expected values.

dependency_constraints.statement: processor.getJavaVersion() must return a value <= 8 for the default-image branch to select adoptopenjdk:8-jre.
dependency_constraints.condition: Only when getFrom() is absent and the default-image branch is used.

dependency_constraints.statement: processor.createLayers() must supply the single visible classes layer and file entry expected by the test.
dependency_constraints.condition: For any successful scenario reaching layer installation in this selected test.

dependency_constraints.statement: processor.computeEntrypoint() must return the four visible expected entrypoint values.
dependency_constraints.condition: Only when the configured custom entrypoint is empty.

dependency_constraints.statement: The configured custom entrypoint itself must equal the four visible expected values.
dependency_constraints.condition: Only when the configured custom entrypoint is non-empty.

dependency_constraints.statement: ContainerBuilders.create must return a builder whose plan has the expected base image and defaults.
dependency_constraints.condition: Only when an explicit base image is configured; its implementation is not visible in the reviewed input.

expected_interactions.statement: processor.createLayers() is called and its result is installed on the builder.
expected_interactions.condition: For any successful scenario reaching plan configuration.

expected_interactions.statement: processor.getJavaVersion() is called to select a default base image.
ContainerBuilders.create is called with the configured image, an empty platform set, common CLI options, and logger.

verification_candidates.statement: Consider verifying createLayers() was called once if that interaction distinguishes the intended scenario.
verification_candidates.condition: Only if interaction verification adds value beyond the visible build-plan assertions.

verification_candidates.statement: Consider verifying computeEntrypoint() only for the empty-custom-entrypoint scenario.
verification_candidates.condition: Only if the chosen scenario explicitly requires an empty configured entrypoint.

evidence.rationale: These are the visible base-image, platform, and creation-time assertions for the selected test.
These are the visible format and empty or unset configuration assertions.
These assertions expose the required entrypoint and the single classes layer, including its exact visible file entry and extraction path.
The code has distinct explicit-image and default-image paths; the Java-version constraint applies only to the latter.
This establishes the unconditional layer call and the conditional choice between computed and custom entrypoints.
The inferred entrypoint and layers are forwarded into the builder together with visible configuration values.

uncertainty.statement: The reviewed input does not show ContainerBuilders.create, so the explicit-image path cannot be ruled in or out as another way to obtain the visible expected plan.
The visible test does not reveal whether the entrypoint came from computeEntrypoint() or from an identical configured custom entrypoint.
uncertainty.condition: Until getEntrypoint() behavior is supplied by the masked setup.
